Halesowen Chiropractic Clinic was established in 2004. The practice has been running for over 22 years in Birmingham UK, led by Chiropractor Dr H Kapur DC (Doctor of Chiropractic).

We are always here to help with any musculoskeletal issues you maybe suffering with.

Enjoy the videos 😊


Address:-

15a Howley Grange Rd
Halesowen 
B62 0HN

0121 423 3101

www.halesowenchiropracticclinic.co.uk
